response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_avg FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_avg) AS region_avg FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS overall_avg FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg AS figure, r.region_avg - o.overall_avg AS amount_above_average, r.region_avg / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_average FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.region_avg > o.overall_avg
